name: Sister Anwen

actions.label: Give Anwen the evidence privately. Stay to protect those who speak.
actions.result: Anwen receives the recovered evidence in private. Kael stays to help protect its living witnesses; their consent to speak remains their own.
actions.preview: Anwen receives the recovered evidence in private. Kael stays to help protect its living witnesses; their consent to speak remains their own.
actions.cost: Public disclosure can expose witnesses; private or retained evidence delays the wider account.

actions.label: Make the evidence public. Stay to keep the witnesses safe.
actions.result: The recovered account is posted beneath the contract. Some doors close. Public evidence does not grant permission to publish a witness's private story.
actions.preview: The recovered account is posted beneath the contract. Some doors close. Public evidence does not grant permission to publish a witness's private story.
actions.cost: Public disclosure can expose witnesses; private or retained evidence delays the wider account.

actions.label: Keep the evidence. Make protected copies and stay with the investigation.
actions.result: Kael keeps the original and commits to copies. Anwen distrusts the delay, but he has promised to remain with the people who must carry the account.
actions.preview: Kael keeps the original and commits to copies. Anwen distrusts the delay, but he has promised to remain with the people who must carry the account.

greeting: Tell me what you found. If some of it is still unknown, say so.
lines: Kael: The pack is dead. Here is what I could establish on the road.

lines.text: Kael: Bram was still gripping the cart brake. His ledger's debts were crossed out.
Kael: Red thread bound the black feathers.
Anwen: My knot. I tied that thread for Sella.
Kael: Oren's wooden crow had his name scraped away.
Kael: Vargan wire bound a name to the creatures. Someone tried to burn it off.
Kael: The drag marks were deliberate. Boots followed the pack's tracks.

lines: Anwen: Give me what you found, show the village, or keep it while we make copies. Do not fill the gaps for anyone.
Anwen: A public account is not permission to speak for the people behind it.
Kael: I will stay. The payment ends the hunt. It does not settle what I now know.
